neighbours.label: a speech or action verb done jointly by a plural subject ('they said together', 'chanted in unison')
fire: "Happy birthday!" the children sang together as she walked in.
The two pilots nodded together and pushed the throttle forward.
"Surprise!" they yelled together from behind the couch.
"Thank you," the sisters whispered together, smiling.
The crowd chanted in unison as the team took the field.
Both girls laughed together at the silly joke.
quiet: "Happy birthday!" her mother sang as she walked in.
The pilot nodded and pushed the throttle forward.
"Surprise!" he yelled from behind the couch.
The announcer shouted loudly as the team took the field.
The girl laughed at the silly joke.

notes: Card: 'they breathed together', 'they said together', 'Teachers:'. Probe: 'they shouted together' 0.30 vs 'she shouted' 0.01. Near misses keep the scene with a single actor.
